rows.jyutping: jung6 daai6 tau4 zam1 ding1 zyu6
rows.note: This is the all-purpose expression for fastening something with a drawing pin or thumbtack.

example.english: I pin the paper down with a drawing pin so the wind will not blow it away.
example.traditional: 我用大頭針釘住張紙，唔使怕風吹走。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 daai6 tau4 zam1 ding1 zyu6 zoeng1 zi2 m4 sai2 paa3 fung1 ceoi1 zau2

rows.note: Use this for physically holding someone down, especially in a fight or on a mat.

example.english: In the fight, I pin him to the ground in one move.
example.traditional: 打交嗰陣，我一下就壓住佢喺地上。
example.jyutping: daa2 gaau1 go2 zan6 ngo5 jat1 haa5 zau6 aat3 zyu6 keoi5 hai2 dei6 soeng6

rows.note: Use 大頭針 as the all-purpose word for an ordinary headed pin used to fasten things.

example.english: I used a pin to fasten the paper to the corkboard.
example.traditional: 我用大頭針將張紙釘喺軟木板上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 daai6 tau4 zam1 zoeng1 zoeng1 zi2 deng1 hai2 jyun5 muk6 baan2 soeng6

rows.note: Use 釘仔 specifically for a small nail driven into wood or another material.

example.english: I used a small nail to pin the wooden board securely in place.
example.traditional: 我用釘仔將塊木板釘返實。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 deng1 zai2 zoeng1 faai3 muk6 baan2 deng1 faan1 sat6

rows.note: Use 插銷 for a removable cylindrical pin or peg that fastens or joins parts of a device.

example.english: The pin on this door has come loose and keeps dropping out.
example.traditional: 呢個門嘅插銷鬆咗，成日自己跌返落嚟。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mun4 ge3 caap3 siu1 sung1 zo2 seng4 jat6 zi6 gei2 dit3 faan1 lok6 lai4

rows.note: Use 針腳 specifically for an individual contact in an electrical connector or electronic component.

example.english: One pin on the plug is bent, so it will not go into the machine.
example.traditional: 插頭有一隻針腳彎咗，插唔入部機。
example.jyutping: caap3 tau4 jau5 jat1 zek3 zam1 goek3 waan1 zo2 caap3 m4 jap6 bou6 gei1
